name: faye-ui-system-engineer
description: Faye UI System Engineer provides visual design, architecture, implementation, source review, and rendered inspection for browser UI screens, components, and reusable systems.

interface.shortDescription: Web UI design, implementation, review, and inspection.
interface.longDescription: Five focused skills cover visual design, architecture, implementation and migration, source review, and rendered inspection for browser-based websites, web applications, PWAs, and browser-based editors or workspaces. Build individual screens and components or reusable UI systems, preserving the host framework and separating chrome from authored content. Includes a dependency-free source scanner and an optional independent UI reviewer definition.
defaultPrompt: Use $ui-visual-design to define the visual direction for this web interface.
Use $ui-system-implementation to build this responsive web screen from the agreed design.
Use $ui-inspection to inspect this screen for visual and usability issues.
